stage_description: Lead record raised against a programme and admission cycle by marketing, walk-in, partner or self-initiated enquiry.
Applicant opened the online application form. Re-opening the form is an engagement day, not a second milestone; the milestone timestamp is the first session.
Application payload submitted on or before the intake round close date. This is the prediction point of the primary task.
Documents received and checked as complete and eligibility-checked. May contain an internal doc-query loop before the milestone is granted.
A formal dated decision (admit or reject) released to the applicant. One decision per application, ever.
Seat allotted and offer conditions cleared. Reached only by admits.
Registration completed and first instalment recorded. Primary target milestone.
